grades: Youth who have completed grades 7 and 8
pay_detail: Registration fee was $250 by May 8, $275 for May 9 to 15 and $300 for May 16 to 22 (2026 prices).
notes: Aimed at incoming 9th graders, so it fits the early end of the guide age range.
name: 4-H Round-Up at Purdue
what_you_do: A three-day stay in a Purdue residence hall for youth who just finished grades 7 and 8. Attend career classes made for Round-Up and get a taste of college life.
who_can_apply: Youth who have completed grades 7 and 8 (so they are entering 9th grade).
deadline_text: 2026 event ran June 10 to 12, 2026. Registration was open through May 22, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up through 4-H Online. Contact your local Purdue Extension office if you need help signing up.
